name: form-records
description: Saves a declared form into an owned store collection, with a confirmation page and an edit page limited to declared fields.

records.description: Record flows by name. Each needs a route <mount>/* with extension: form-records (GET, HEAD, POST) and a principal-providing policy such as auth: true; records are private to their signed-in creator.

mount.description: URL path of the flow: <mount> is the new-record form, <mount>/<id> the saved record's confirmation, <mount>/<id>/edit the edit page and, with list, <mount>/ the caller's records.

collection.description: A store collection declared with ownership: owner; each mapped form field must be type-compatible with its collection field. Activation fails otherwise.

title.description: Page heading and title of the form.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone (default UTC) that defines "today" for relative date bounds; refused at activation when unknown.

confirmation.description: The page a valid submission leads to.

message.description: Confirmation text; a {field} placeholder is replaced by that submitted value (escaped) and must be listed in show.

show.description: Declared fields whose submitted values the confirmation may display: carried in a sealed five-minute cookie on redirect, or rendered directly inline. Nothing else is echoed.

success.description: What a valid POST answers: redirect (default) is a 303 to <mount>/confirmation; inline renders the confirmation in the POST response.

status.description: Status of the inline confirmation (default 200); refused with mode redirect.

label.description: Visible label of the field; also names it in error messages and on the confirmation.

control.description: HTML control (default input). select needs options; checkbox takes no type or bounds and submits true or false.

type.description: Input type for an input control (default text); decides which bounds apply and how the value is checked.

required.description: Fields are required unless this is false. Not allowed together with requiredWhen.

minLength.description: Fewest characters a text value may have; not for number, date or checkbox fields.

maxLength.description: Most characters a text value may have; required (and bounded) when pattern is set.

minimum.description: Lower bound: a number for type number; for date and datetime-local an absolute YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM value, today, or {from: today, add: <duration>} in the flow's timeZone.

from.description: The flow's current date in its timeZone.

add.description: Signed ISO 8601 period of years, months and days added to today, for example P30D or -P18Y.

maximum.description: Upper bound, with the same forms as minimum; it must not be below minimum.

from.description: The flow's current date in its timeZone.

add.description: Signed ISO 8601 period of years, months and days added to today, for example P30D or -P18Y.

pattern.description: Regular expression the whole text value must match; checked for catastrophic backtracking at activation and requires maxLength.

enum.description: Exact values an input accepts, or the subset of a select's option values it accepts.

description.description: Help text rendered under the field.

requiredWhen.description: Makes the field required only when a sibling select or enum field was submitted once with one of the listed values, and optional otherwise. Replaces required; the sibling must not itself be conditional.

field.description: Name of the sibling field in this flow; it needs a fixed value set (a select or an enum input).

in.description: Values of the sibling that make this field required; each must be one the sibling accepts.

options.description: Choices of a select control, in display order; only select fields take options.

label.description: Visible text of the choice; the confirmation shows it for a shown select.

fields.description: The form's fields in display order, keyed by field name (the submitted name). A field not declared here is refused.

form.description: The form, in the forms flow shape without a mount (and without abuse or notify); forms renders and validates it.

fields.description: Map from form field to collection field. Default: each form field to the collection field of the same name.

editable.description: Form fields the edit page may change; every other field is read-only after create. Default: none, and no edit page.

editTitle.description: Title of the edit page. Default: the form's title.

list.description: Adds a page at <mount>/ listing the signed-in user's own records (paginated; needs ui). Default: no list page.

title.description: Title of the list page. Default: Your records.

columns.description: Form fields shown as columns, in this order.

authoring.description: Save a declared form into an owned store collection: a submission creates a record private to its signed-in creator, the confirmation page reads the saved record back, and an edit page changes only the fields listed in `editable`. forms keeps rendering, CSRF and validation; the store keeps ownership, limits and ETags. No handler code.

surfaces.name: records
surfaces.description: Each record flow: `mount`, the owned store `collection`, the `form` (a forms flow without a mount: title, submitLabel, confirmation with `show`, optional `success` (`{mode: inline, status: 200|201}` answers a create or edit with the saved record's confirmation instead of a 303 to `<mount>/<id>`; an edit is always 200), fields), the optional `fields` map from form field to collection field, `editable` form fields, `editTitle` and an optional `list` page (`title`, `columns` of form fields).

surfaces.name: mount
surfaces.description: Mount each record flow as `<mount>/*` with GET, HEAD and POST and a principal-providing policy such as `auth: true` (forms verifies its own CSRF token, which a plain HTML form posts in the body). It serves `<mount>` (new record), `<mount>/<id>` (confirmation), `<mount>/<id>/edit` and, with `list`, `<mount>/` (the caller's own records).

agent.description: Local, revision-pinned references for agents configuring the form-records extension.

references.name: form-records extension guide
references.description: Configuration and composition guidance for saving a form into an owned store collection; ends with the generated field reference for every configuration key.
